1: // Game: Neon Runner – minimal endless runner
2: // Canvas with id="game" must exist in the HTML.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas with id "game" not found');
7:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
8:   const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
9:   canvas.width = canvas.offsetWidth * dpr;
10:   canvas.height = canvas.offsetHeight * dpr;
11:   ctx.scale(dpr, dpr);
12: 
13:   const WIDTH = canvas.offsetWidth;
14:   const HEIGHT = canvas.offsetHeight;
15: 
16:   // Player – neon line (simple rectangle)
17:   const player = {
18:     x: 50,
19:     y: HEIGHT - 20,
20:     width: 10,
21:     height: 20,
22:     vy: 0,
23:     jumpStrength: -7,
24:     gravity: 0.3,
25:     onGround: true,
26:     color: '#0ff',
27:   };
28: 
29:   // Obstacles – moving rectangles
30:   const obstacles = [];
31:   const obstacleSpeed = 3;
32:   const obstacleSpawnInterval = 1500; // ms
33:   let lastSpawn = 0;
34: 
35:   let gameOver = false;
36:   let score = 0;
37: 
38:   function spawnObstacle() {
39:     const width = 20 + Math.random() * 30;
40:     const height = 20 + Math.random() * 40;
41:     obstacles.push({
42:       x: WIDTH,
43:       y: HEIGHT - height,
44:       width,
45:       height,
46:       color: '#f0f',
47:     });
48:   }
49: 
50:   function update(dt) {
51:     if (gameOver) return;
52:     // Player physics
53:     player.vy += player.gravity;
54:     player.y += player.vy;
55:     if (player.y + player.height >= HEIGHT) {
56:       player.y = HEIGHT - player.height;
57:       player.vy = 0;
58:       player.onGround = true;
59:     } else {
60:       player.onGround = false;
61:     }
62: 
63:     // Obstacles movement
64:     for (let i = obstacles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
65:       const o = obstacles[i];
66:       o.x -= obstacleSpeed;
67:       // Remove off‑screen obstacles
68:       if (o.x + o.width < 0) {
69:         obstacles.splice(i, 1);
70:         score++;
71:       }
72:     }
73: 
74:     // Collision detection
75:     for (const o of obstacles) {
76:       if (
77:         player.x < o.x + o.width &&
78:         player.x + player.width > o.x &&
79:         player.y < o.y + o.height &&
80:         player.y + player.height > o.y
81:       ) {
82:         gameOver = true;
83:         break;
84:       }
85:     }
86: 
87:     // Spawn new obstacles
88:     if (performance.now() - lastSpawn > obstacleSpawnInterval) {
89:       spawnObstacle();
90:       lastSpawn = performance.now();
91:     }
92:   }
93: 
94:   function render() {
95:     // Clear background
96:     ctx.fillStyle = '#111';
97:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, WIDTH, HEIGHT);
98: 
99:     // Draw player
100:     ctx.fillStyle = player.color;
101:     ctx.fillRect(player.x, player.y, player.width, player.height);
102: 
103:     // Draw obstacles
104:     for (const o of obstacles) {
105:       ctx.fillStyle = o.color;
106:       ctx.fillRect(o.x, o.y, o.width, o.height);
107:     }
108: 
109:     // Score
110:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
111:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
112:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 10, 20);
113: 
114:     // Game over overlay
115:     if (gameOver) {
116:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
117:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, WIDTH, HEIGHT);
118:       ctx.fillStyle = '#f88';
119:       ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';
120:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
121:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', WIDTH / 2, HEIGHT / 2 - 10);
122:       ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, WIDTH / 2, HEIGHT / 2 + 20);
123:     }
124:   }
125: 
126:   function loop(timestamp) {
127:     const dt = timestamp - (loop.last || timestamp);
128:     loop.last = timestamp;
129:     update(dt);
130:     render();
131:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
132:   }
133: 
134:   // Input handling – jump on click or spacebar
135:   function jump() {
136:     if (player.onGround) {
137:       player.vy = player.jumpStrength;
138:       player.onGround = false;
139:     }
140:   }
141:   canvas.addEventListener('click', jump);
142:   window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
143:     if (e.code === 'Space') jump();
144:   });
145: 
146:   // Start the game loop
147:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
148: })();
